title: Elderly Couple Sitting on Couch, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot from the mid-1950s featuring an elderly couple seated closely on a dark upholstered couch decorated with handmade lace doilies. The gentleman is wearing a white dress shirt with a wide patterned tie, trousers, and polished shoes. The woman wears a floral dress and white shoes. The photograph has scalloped edges typical of mid-20th century snapshot prints.
